whatChanged: The connection check no longer requires an external site: the tunnel is confirmed by a fresh exchange, traffic counters and a DNS lookup through the tunnel; the site probe is optional and off by default.
Candidate order: selected profile, then same-endpoint protocol variants, then other profiles.
Live link watchdog (15 s) with auto-reconnect and 5/15 s backoff until the server returns.
Version 0.23.1+5016; Android installs in place over 0.23.0.
